dek: Set for 25 October 2026 at AEON BiG Puchong Utama in Selangor, this JomRun-powered half marathon offers three distances with registration open. A convenient Klang Valley suburb race where the mall-anchored venue handles logistics that standalone road starts struggle with.
verdict: The Puchong Half Marathon Powered by JomRun is a convenient, accessible Klang Valley suburb race anchored at AEON BiG Puchong Utama, a retail location with ample parking, pre-race shelter, and post-race food options. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) with registration open via JomRun. Puchong is one of Selangor largest population centres roughly 30 minutes south of KL, making this a practical choice for Klang Valley runners. October in Selangor is the inter-monsoon period with warm, humid conditions and a moderate chance of afternoon thunderstorms. The AEON BiG venue provides the familiar mall-anchored advantages, and JomRun registration infrastructure ensures a smooth sign-up experience. For Klang Valley runners wanting a low-friction half marathon with open registration and practical logistics, this is a solid, bookable pick for 25 October 2026.

paragraphs: Puchong is one of the Klang Valley most populous suburbs, with a large running community and easy access from KL and Petaling Jaya via the LDP and KESAS highways. AEON BiG Puchong Utama, the race venue, is a mall-anchored retail location providing ample parking, pre-race shelter, and post-race food options. For Klang Valley runners, this is one of the most logistically accessible race venues in Selangor [1][2].
sections.heading: Puchong: KL Southern Suburb

paragraphs: Registration is open through JomRun, Malaysia dominant race-registration platform. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) cover the full running spectrum. JomRun registration infrastructure means online sign-up, digital payment, and clear entitlement breakdowns. Pricing was not prominently published but JomRun half marathons in this tier typically range from MYR 65-90 [1].
sections.heading: JomRun Platform and Registration

paragraphs: The course starts and finishes at AEON BiG Puchong Utama, extending onto the municipal roads of Puchong. Puchong road network is a mix of wide arterial roads and residential streets. The terrain is gently rolling rather than pancake-flat. Traffic on a Sunday morning in Puchong is moderate but manageable, and the AEON BiG venue provides parking, toilets, and shelter that a standalone road start cannot match [1].
sections.heading: The Course: AEON BiG to Puchong Roads

paragraphs: October sits in the inter-monsoon window between the southwest and northeast monsoons. Expect morning temperatures of 25-28C with humidity around 80-85 percent, climbing toward 31C by late morning. Afternoon thunderstorms are common but rarely affect a morning half-marathon start. The flat-to-rolling terrain and October climate combine for reasonable racing conditions [3].
sections.heading: October in Selangor: Inter-Monsoon

paragraphs: Race-kit collection is likely at AEON BiG Puchong Utama itself, eliminating the common frustration of travelling to a separate expo venue. The mall-anchored finish area means post-race food, air-conditioned recovery, and parking are all within walking distance. This is a practical, logistics-first event rather than a festival-style race [1].
